2607.14315.title: Towards a Unified Multidimensional Explainability Metric: Evaluating Trustworthiness in AI Models
2607.14315.paper_summary: In this paper, we present a comprehensive framework for assessing the explainability of various XAI methods, such as LIME and SHAP, across multiple datasets and machine learning models, with the ultimate goal of creating a unified multidimensional explainability score. Our methodology focuses on three key aspects of explainability: fidelity, simplicity, and stability. We leverage benchmarking experiments to systematically evaluate these aspects and use the insights gained to construct an offline knowledge base. This knowledge base captures the explainability scores for each registered model and serves as a valuable resource for context-dependent evaluation of explainability. By analyzing the complementary characteristics and metadata of AI models, datasets, and XAI methods, the knowledge base will enable the estimation of explainability scores for previously unseen datasets and models. Properties like fidelity, simplicity, and stability may vary significantly based on the dataset, underlying model, and domain expertise of the end user. We demonstrate our framework by applying it to three open-source datasets, discussing the implications of the obtained results in relation to the characteristics of the datasets. Our work contributes to the growing field of XAI by providing a robust and versatile tool for evaluating and comparing the explainability of various XAI methods, ultimately supporting the development of more transparent and trustworthy AI systems.
2607.14315.paper_summary_zh: 在本文中，我們提出了一個全面的框架，用於評估各種 XAI 方法（如 LIME 和 SHAP）在多個數據集和機器學習模型中的可解釋性，最終目標是創建一個統一的多維可解釋性分數。<lb/>我們的方法論專注於可解釋性的三個關鍵方面：真實性、簡單性和穩定性。<lb/>我們利用基準實驗系統地評估這些方面，並利用獲得的見解來構建離線知識庫。<lb/>這個知識庫捕捉每個註冊模型的可解釋性分數，並作為上下文依賴的可解釋性評估的寶貴資源。<lb/>通過分析 AI 模型、數據集和 XAI 方法的互補特徵和元數據，該知識庫將使得能夠估算以前未見過的數據集和模型的可解釋性分數。<lb/>像真實性、簡單性和穩定性等特性可能會根據數據集、底層模型和最終用戶的領域專業知識而顯著變化。<lb/>我們通過將框架應用於三個開源數據集來展示我們的框架，並討論所獲結果與數據集特徵之間的影響。<lb/>我們的工作為不斷增長的 XAI 領域做出了貢獻，提供了一個強大而多功能的工具，用於評估和比較各種 XAI 方法的可解釋性，最終支持更透明和可信的 AI 系統的發展。
